question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

CONQUER
solution:
The correct answer is** 'Option 1' **i.e. **'Surrender'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"CONQUER" **means to overcome, defeat, or gain control over something or someone through force or superior power. (जीतना)
 
• **It implies** a victorious and dominant position.
 
• **"Surrender"** means to give up, yield, or submit to someone or something. (आत्मसमर्पण)
 
• **It denotes** a situation where one gives in or accepts defeat rather than trying to overcome or control.

Therefore, the** correct answer** is: '**Surrender'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **"Crush" **indicate defeating or overwhelming someone or something.(पीसना/कुचलना)
 
• **"Subdue"** means to bring under control or to suppress. (दबाना/नियंत्रित करना)
 
• **"Overthrow" **means to remove or forcefully displace a ruler or government (पदाघात करना/विलुप्त करना)
